title: UR HERE
blurb: A living infographic of where we are in time. Ride the UR·HERE Express from Earth's formation to the red giant sun, get off at each station and find Sunni, the man whose head is a sundial, with his rooster, nature's clock.
controls: Tap ◂ ▸ or a station number to ride; GET OFF to explore; drag to look around, tap Sunni's sundial head; tabs switch between Earth, 1M years and one life
